overall_goal: Slice a piece of bread and add it to the salad bowl

goals.description: Take the baguette out of its bag and cut a slice
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the baguette from its bag, grabs a knife, and cuts a slice of bread.

goals.description: Cut the bread slice into smaller pieces and place them in the salad bowl
goals.rationale: The person halves the bread slice on the cutting board and then transfers the pieces into the salad bowl.
